beats.headline: THREE MASTERS
beats.text: One man worked for America's drug agency, trained with Lashkar-e-Taiba, and took money from Pakistani intelligence.

beats.headline: THE BARGAIN
beats.text: Every time he was caught, he made a deal.

beats.headline: THE TOURIST
beats.text: He checked into the Taj, filmed the routes, and marked the targets for 26/11.

beats.headline: FIVE WARNINGS
beats.text: His own wives warned US authorities. "He's either a terrorist, or he's working for you."

beats.headline: THE MERCENARY
beats.text: The Mercenary. Now on The Sisodia Files.
